instruction: In cell H2, write a SUMIF formula to calculate the total Sales for Invoice No. 10503.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully created a pivot table in Sheet2 counting Invoice No. occurrences. It navigated menus, inserted a new sheet, and built the pivot table correctly in 31 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can create new sheets, build pivot tables/summary tables, use LibreOffice Calc menus and data tools, navigate cells, enter formulas
metadata.task_rationale: Original task used pivot tables for aggregation. This variation tests a simpler but related skill - using SUMIF formula for conditional aggregation on the same data.
metadata.explanation: Task requires writing a SUMIF formula in H2 that sums Sales (column G) where Invoice No. (column A) equals 10503. Expected result is 1545 (525+352+128+540). Getter reads H2 value with data_only=True to get computed result.

scoring_breakdown.h2_value: 1.0 - Cell H2 contains 1545 (SUMIF result for Invoice 10503)
